mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for two consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises by more than 1% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%, the combination signals a potential inflationary surge amidst loose monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: loose monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%, yet 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises by more than 10% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and FEDFUNDS is above 2%, the combination signals a potential economic slowdown amidst tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 consecutive quarters and FEDFUNDS > 2%
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with economic slowdown
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is negative for two consecutive quarters and FEDFUNDS is above 2%, yet 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
